tips.text: Set matchmaking to Solo before entering Pontis Tower to fly your own Railjack; squads always get a loaner.
Raise your Railjack intrinsics first; they still apply on the loaner ship.
Shoot every green target in the flying segment yourself; the bonus Talent is personal loot.
Run Steel Path when you can handle it; clears take about 7 minutes and pay more Talent.
Buy a missing part from Hunhow as soon as the Talent covers it; duplicate blueprints never turn back into Talent.
Restart the game if three runs in a row give the same blueprint; the reward table can stick.
Expect the flying targets on this node to be much easier to track than the Orowyrm's.
Most players call this farm easy; some finish in about six runs, with the weapon parts taking longest.
